settings.title: Before you write
settings.text: These cover most questions we get.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as your coffee ships — usually within 24 hours of roasting.

settings.question: Can I change my grind after ordering?
settings.answer: Yes, until roasting day. Just reply to your order confirmation.

settings.question: Do you supply cafés?
settings.answer: We do — see our Wholesale page or write to wholesale@altura.coffee.
